# Parse each file and move to new structure
import os

base_dir = "~/documents/work/meetings_data/"
files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=base_dir, entry_type='files')

for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename from path
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    # Split by "__" to get date and rest
    date_part, rest = filename.split('__', 1)
    # rest is like "slides.ppt" or "video_recording.mp4"
    file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    # New directory: file_name
    new_dir = base_dir + file_name + "/"
    # New file path: new_dir + date_part + "." + ext
    new_file_path = new_dir + date_part + "." + ext
    # Create directory if not exists
    if not apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=new_dir):
        apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=new_dir, recursive=True)
    # Move file
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=fs_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=new_file_path)
    print(f"Moved {file_path} -> {new_file_path}: {result}")
